title: Salesforce selects Legora to further support its global legal team operations
summary: Legora, the agentic operating system for legal professionals, today announced that Salesforce has adopted Legora across its Legal and Corporate Affairs organization in North America, EMEA, and APAC, complementing its use of Agentforce and Slack.
body_markdown:
Legora, the agentic operating system for legal professionals, today announced that Salesforce has adopted Legora across its Legal and Corporate Affairs organization in North America, EMEA, and APAC, complementing its use of Agentforce and Slack.


“AI is reshaping how legal teams operate, and with Slack and Agentforce we're building an AI-native, trust-first legal function that empowers our team to work more efficiently and focus their time where it can have the greatest impact. Adding Legora to our transformation portfolio gives our team additional legal tools to support research, drafting, and other workflows, so they can spend more time on the work that requires their expertise and judgment,” said **Erica Swainson, VP, Legal Innovation & Strategic Initiatives, Salesforce** .


The global rollout builds on Salesforce's broader focus on AI adoption within its legal organization. The Legora aOS is a single connected system of AI tools that plan, execute, review, and deliver legal work end-to-end, with lawyers staying in control where judgment is required. This enables Salesforce's legal team to stay ahead of the evolving regulatory landscape, apply consistent negotiating positions at scale, and handle more research and drafting directly.


“Salesforce's decision to adopt Legora reflects a broader shift in how in-house legal teams are embracing agentic AI. It’s part of the critical infrastructure they depend on to run comprehensive legal workflows,” said **Max Junestrand, CEO and Co-Founder of Legora** .


Legora will be at Dreamforce in San Francisco from September 15-17, 2026. Attendees can learn more about the future of agentic legal work and Legora's collaboration with Salesforce in a fireside chat between Max Junestrand and Sabastian Niles, President and Chief Legal Officer of Salesforce, on September 16.


**About Legora**


Legora is the agentic operating system for legal work, supporting lawyers in research, review, and drafting across complex matters. It is used by more than 100,000 legal professionals at more than 1,800 leading law firms and in-house legal teams across over 50 markets.
